name: "Bedlam Spirits"
description: The Bedlam Spirits were an omnipotent group of entities that inhabited the planet Bedlam near the Bedlam Pulsar. They consisted of Tilotny, Horliss-Horliss, Cold Danda Sine and Splendid Ap. The spirits were very powerful beings, capable of manipulating time and mass. However, they were prone to childish behavior.

distinctions: Ability to manipulate time and matter
